objective: Improve the RFI investigation-QA capability until it meets the predetermined calibration success criteria while preserving reference truth, architectural authority boundaries, and benchmark integrity.

partition.rerandomization: Permitted only before any calibration outcome if the recorded seed fails coverage_preflight. Each rejected seed and reason must be preserved.

runtime.adapter: fresh ephemeral codex exec context per independent run
runtime.model: Codex CLI default; no model override

stopping_rules.success: Stop and freeze when one terminal three-run calibration assessment satisfies every scoring-contract threshold.
stopping_rules.budget: Stop and freeze the best predeclared design when any optimization budget is exhausted.
stopping_rules.stall: Stop after two consecutive full diagnostic calibration iterations improve weighted diagnostic utility by less than 0.02 and do not turn any previously failing primary threshold into a pass.
stopping_rules.diagnostic_utility: 0.20 disposition_accuracy + 0.15 (1-material_false_accept_rate) + 0.10 (1-supported_false_reject_rate) + 0.15 material_finding_recall + 0.10 defect_class_attribution_f1 + 0.10 evidence_grounding_rate + 0.05 (1-unsupported_finding_rate) + 0.05 indeterminate_accuracy + 0.10 matched_pair_discrimination
stopping_rules.reference_defect: Quarantine the affected case from further optimization feedback without changing it; report it for independent adjudication. It remains a scored failure unless an independently issued benchmark version replaces the corpus in a future task.
